evidence: Touches `src/torcontrol.cpp` to validate Tor control responses and cached keys, matching the P2P label and Tor integration scope.
rationale: Prevents command and argument injection into the Tor control daemon caused by unescaped CRLF line breaks and spaces in onion keys. As noted in the description, an unprivileged local process could otherwise seed the cache via the loopback endpoint while Tor is offline to inject commands like `SIGNAL SHUTDOWN` upon reconnecting.
